stories.title: Nepal-China border flood death toll passes 682, nearly 2,500 still missing
stories.reason: A tsunami-like wall of water and debris swept through Himalayan villages this week, and rescue crews racing through a fourth day of searching still can't account for thousands of people.

stories.title: Trump announces deal with Venezuela to secure more than 65 billion barrels of oil reserves
stories.reason: The US would take 55% effective output of a new company controlling 17 Venezuelan oil fields, more than doubling US reserves as the administration scrambles to counter Iran-war-driven fuel prices.

stories.title: Nvidia agrees to buy Hugging Face for $12.9 billion
stories.reason: Buying the most widely used hub for open-source AI models would give Nvidia unprecedented reach into the software layer of the AI ecosystem it already dominates in hardware.

stories.title: Advent, Stripe abandon $50 billion pursuit of PayPal
stories.reason: Shares tumbled as much as 16% after the consortium walked away rather than raise its bid, ending months of speculation over what would have been one of the largest leveraged buyouts ever.

stories.title: Iran's foreign minister accuses US and Israel-aligned actors of manipulating energy markets
stories.reason: Araghchi says intelligence shows deliberate efforts to game energy prices and prolong the war, a sign the six-month-old conflict is now also a battle over economic narrative.

stories.title: Amazon Mechanical Turk to shut down September 30 after 21 years
stories.reason: The crowdsourced-labor platform that once trained much of the AI industry's data is closing as AI systems increasingly perform the simple tasks it used to outsource to humans.

stories.title: Meta closes another loophole letting people record discreetly with smart glasses
stories.reason: The second privacy fix in two months shows how quickly bystander-surveillance concerns are becoming a real liability for the smart-glasses category Meta is betting on.

stories.title: Google transfers A2A protocol to the Agentic AI Foundation
stories.reason: Consolidating agent-communication standards under neutral Linux Foundation governance, alongside Anthropic's MCP, is a step toward AI agents from different vendors actually working together.
